rationale: Price has rallied from the entry of $6.27 to $6.35 with the last candle posting a high of $6.35 and closing there, showing no downside follow-through; the bid/ask of $6.36/$6.39 puts the market squarely at the 9-EMA and within striking distance of the $6.40 invalidation, meaning the risk/reward on continuing to hold has deteriorated sharply.
